summary: Bundled skill scripts invoke curl/ping with no install-time execution path
details: The package bundles a collection of 'skill' resources under bundled-skills/, including Python scrapers (junta-leiloeiros/scripts/base_scraper.py, serve_api.py) that use ping/GET/POST, a shell helper (loki-mode/benchmarks/run-benchmarks.sh) that invokes curl, an rclone installer helper (rclone-cli/scripts/install.sh) that fetches from https://rclone.org (the official rclone project domain), and a verify.sh under youtube-notetaker/scripts that calls curl against GET endpoints. These scripts are inert data assets within the package tree rather than reachable code paths; package.json does not wire them into lifecycle hooks, and they only execute if a user explicitly invokes the corresponding skill. Network destinations observed are the official rclone project site and ordinary HTTP verbs in scraper utilities, with no hardcoded attacker endpoint, no credential or environment harvesting, no obfuscation, and no auto-execution on npm install or module import.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
